title: Kroneckerised Particle Mesh Ewald
summary: Particle Mesh Ewald (PME) methods accelerated through Fast Fourier Transforms (FFTs) for their reciprocal part are widely used to solve N -body problems over periodic structures with Laplace-like kernels. The FFT dependence of classical PME may mitigate its performance on parallel distributed-memory architectures. We here introduce a new variant of the reciprocal part based on Sum of Kronecker Products (SKP) instead of FFT.
